title: Realtime Speech to Speech
description: Real-time voice conversations with Grok models via WebSocket. The connection begins with an HTTP GET that is upgraded to WebSocket (status 101). Once connected, the client and server exchange JSON messages to configure the session, stream audio, and receive responses. For SIP calls, connect with the `call_id` from a `realtime.call.incoming` webhook.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for authentication. Use your xAI API key (server-side only) or an ephemeral client secret from the Create client secret endpoint.

headers.name: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
headers.description: Alternative authentication for browser clients. Pass the ephemeral token with prefix `xai-client-secret.`. When provided, the Authorization header is not required.

queryParameters.name: call_id
queryParameters.description: SIP call identifier from a `realtime.call.incoming` webhook. When provided, the WebSocket connects to that inbound SIP call. Authenticate with an xAI API key; ephemeral client secrets are not supported for SIP `call_id` sessions.

queryParameters.name: model
queryParameters.description: Model to use for the session. Ignored when `call_id` is provided because the session is bound to the inbound SIP call. Use grok-voice-latest for the best experience on direct WebSocket sessions.

queryParameters.name: reasoning.effort
queryParameters.description: Controls whether the model uses reasoning. Defaults to `high`.

clientMessages.description: Update session configuration such as system prompt, voice, audio format, turn detection, and tools.

model.description: Model to use for the session. Defaults to `grok-voice-latest`. Can also be set at connection time via the `model` query parameter.

instructions.description: System prompt for the voice agent.

reasoning.description: Reasoning settings for models that support them.

effort.description: Controls whether the model uses reasoning. Defaults to `high`. Can also be set at connection time via the `reasoning.effort` query parameter.

voice.description: Voice identifier. Use a built-in voice (e.g. Eve, Ara) or a custom voice ID.

type.description: `"server_vad"` for automatic detection, `null` for manual text turns.

idle_timeout_ms.description: When set, the server proactively re-engages the user if no speech is detected for this many milliseconds after the assistant finishes responding, emitting `input_audio_buffer.timeout_triggered` and generating a check-in. Re-arms after every response. Default: null (disabled).

resumption.description: Session resumption settings (xAI extension). Caches conversation turns keyed by the `conversation_id` query parameter and replays them on reconnect.

enabled.description: Opt in to session resumption so prior turns are replayed to the model on reconnect. Default: false.

audio.description: Audio format and transport for input and output. `format` selects the codec; `transport` selects the wire path. Default transport is `json` (base64 in Realtime events). Set `transport` to `binary` to send/receive raw codec bytes as WebSocket binary frames (no protocol header). For `audio/opus`, each payload is one raw Opus packet (24 kHz). Input dual-accepts both channels for the configured format; output emits on the configured transport only. Mid-session `output.transport` changes apply at the next response boundary.

type.description: Audio encoding format. `audio/pcm` for raw PCM, `audio/pcmu` for G.711 u-law (telephony), `audio/pcma` for G.711 A-law (telephony), `audio/opus` for raw Opus packets (24 kHz).

rate.description: Sample rate in Hz (PCM only). Default: 24000. Use 8000 for telephony (G.711).

transport.description: Preferred wire path for input audio. `json` (default): base64 in `input_audio_buffer.append`. `binary`: raw codec bytes as WebSocket binary frames. Server accepts both for the configured format (dual-accept).

transcription.description: Transcription configuration for the user's input audio.

language_hint.description: BCP-47 language code (e.g. `ja`, `ar`, `es-MX`, `pt-BR`) to bias ASR transcription toward a specific language. Can be updated mid-session.

keyterms.description: Key terms to bias transcription toward (e.g. product names, proper nouns). Repeat for each term. Max 100 terms, each up to 50 characters. Can be updated mid-session.

type.description: Audio encoding format. `audio/pcm` for raw PCM, `audio/pcmu` for G.711 u-law (telephony), `audio/pcma` for G.711 A-law (telephony), `audio/opus` for raw Opus packets (24 kHz).

rate.description: Sample rate in Hz (PCM only). Default: 24000. Use 8000 for telephony (G.711).

transport.description: Wire path for assistant audio. `json` (default): base64 in `response.output_audio.delta` / `response.audio.delta`. `binary`: raw codec bytes as WebSocket binary frames (lifecycle events remain JSON). Changes apply at the next response boundary.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier for assistant audio output. Range: 0.7–1.5. Default: 1.0. Values below 1.0 slow down speech; values above 1.0 speed it up.

tools.description: Tools available to the voice agent.

description.description: Description of what the function does.

parameters.description: JSON Schema object describing the function parameters.

location.description: For `web_search` type: optional location context for search results. Also accepted under the text-API name `user_location`.

country.description: Country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

allowed_domains.description: For `web_search` type: only include results from these domains (no protocol or path). Mutually exclusive with `excluded_domains` — do not set both on the same tool.

excluded_domains.description: For `web_search` type: exclude results from these domains. Mutually exclusive with `allowed_domains` — do not set both on the same tool.

allowed_x_handles.description: For `x_search` type: only include posts from these X handles (without `@`). Mutually exclusive with `excluded_x_handles` — do not set both on the same tool.

excluded_x_handles.description: For `x_search` type: exclude posts from these X handles. Mutually exclusive with `allowed_x_handles` — do not set both on the same tool.

from_date.description: For `x_search` type: only consider posts from this date, ISO-8601 `YYYY-MM-DD`. Must not be later than `to_date`.

to_date.description: For `x_search` type: only consider posts up to this date, ISO-8601 `YYYY-MM-DD`.

enable_image_understanding.description: For `web_search` and `x_search` types: let the agent view images found in results.

enable_video_understanding.description: For `x_search` type: let the agent view videos in posts.

vector_store_ids.description: For `file_search` type: array of vector store IDs to search.

max_num_results.description: For `file_search` type: maximum number of results to return.

server_label.description: For `mcp` type: unique label for the MCP server (no dots allowed, use hyphens).

server_url.description: For `mcp` type: URL of the MCP server.

allowed_tools.description: For `mcp` type: optional list of tool names to allow from this server.

authorization.description: For `mcp` type: optional authorization token to send with requests.

headers.description: For `mcp` type: optional custom headers to send with requests.

server_description.description: For `mcp` type: optional description of the MCP server for the model.

replace.description: Spoken-text find-and-replace map applied to the model's output before TTS, e.g. `{"Acme Mobile": "Acme Mobull"}`. Each key is matched case-insensitively on whole-word boundaries with the configured replacement casing preserved; longest match wins. Changes only the spoken audio, not the transcript the user sees. The applied map is echoed back on `session.updated`.

clientMessages.description: Append chunks of base64-encoded audio data to the input buffer. The server does not send back a corresponding message.
Commit the audio buffer as a user message. Only available when `turn_detection` type is `null`. Confirmed by `input_audio_buffer.committed` from the server.
Create a new conversation item. Can be a user text message, an assistant text message for history seeding, a function call for seeding tool-use history, or a function call output.

previous_item_id.description: Optional. Used to insert the turn into a specific position in history.

oneOf.title: Message
oneOf.description: A text message from a user, assistant, or system role.

role.description: Role of the message sender. Use `user` for user messages, `assistant` for seeding assistant history, or `system` for system-level context.

type.description: Content type. Use `input_text` for user text input, `input_audio` for user audio input, `text` for general text, or `audio` for audio content.

text.description: Text content. Used with `input_text` or `text` content types.

audio.description: Base64-encoded audio data. Used with `input_audio` or `audio` content types.

transcript.description: Transcript of the audio content, if available.

oneOf.title: Function call
oneOf.description: Inject an assistant-initiated function call into the conversation history. Use this to seed tool-use history when reconnecting or restoring a previous session. Pair with a corresponding `function_call_output` item to provide the tool result.

name.description: The name of the function that was called.

arguments.description: JSON string of the function arguments.

call_id.description: The unique identifier for this function call. Use the same `call_id` in the corresponding `function_call_output` item.

oneOf.title: Function call output
oneOf.description: Return the result of a function call to the model. Send this after receiving a `response.function_call_arguments.done` event, then call `response.create` to continue.

output.description: JSON string of the function result.

oneOf.title: Force message
oneOf.description: Make the agent speak a hard-coded, TTS-synthesized line (not model-generated). The server synthesizes the text, injects a full response lifecycle (`response.created` → audio deltas → `response.done`), and records the utterance in conversation context as an assistant message. Do not send `response.create` after this — the force message is the complete turn. xAI extension; not part of the OpenAI Realtime API.

content.description: Array with a single content part containing the text to synthesize.

text.description: Verbatim text to synthesize via TTS.

interruptible.description: Whether the user can interrupt playback by speaking. When `false`, caller audio is dropped until playback completes. Default: `true`.

clientMessages.description: Clear the input audio buffer. Use this to discard any pending audio data without committing it.
Delete a conversation item by ID. The server confirms deletion with a `conversation.item.deleted` event.

item_id.description: The ID of the conversation item to delete.

clientMessages.description: Truncate a previous assistant audio message item. Removes audio and transcript content after the specified duration, keeping only the content up to that point. The server confirms with a `conversation.item.truncated` event.

item_id.description: The ID of the assistant message item to truncate.

content_index.description: Index of the content part to truncate.

audio_end_ms.description: How many milliseconds of audio the client has actually played back before the interruption. Audio and transcript after this point is removed from the conversation context.

clientMessages.description: Request the server to create a new assistant response. This is handled automatically when using server-side VAD.

instructions.description: Per-response system prompt override. When set, this replaces the session-level `instructions` for this response only — subsequent responses revert to the session instructions. Useful for injecting dynamic context or changing behavior for a single turn without updating the session.

metadata.description: Developer-provided key-value pairs attached to this response, echoed back on `response.created` and `response.done`. Useful for correlating responses with what triggered them. Up to 16 pairs; keys up to 64 characters, string values up to 512 characters.

clientMessages.description: Cancel an in-progress response. In VAD mode, interruptions are automatic — use this for manual cancel in non-VAD mode.

response_id.description: Optional. The ID of the response to cancel. If not provided, cancels the current in-progress response.

serverMessages.description: Sent automatically on WebSocket connection. Contains the session configuration.

model.description: The model used for this session.

instructions.description: System prompt for the voice agent.

reasoning.description: Reasoning settings for the session when supported by the selected model.

effort.description: Reasoning setting for the session when supported by the selected model. Defaults to `high`.

voice.description: Voice identifier. Use a built-in voice (e.g. Eve, Ara) or a custom voice ID.

replace.description: Spoken-text find-and-replace map currently applied to the session (see `session.update`).

serverMessages.description: The first message on connection. Notifies the client that a conversation session has been created.

serverMessages.description: Streaming transcription update for the user's audio input. Emitted as the user speaks, providing the cumulative transcript so far before the final `completed` event. Note that this is the cumulative transcript which may have corrections to previous updated transcripts — this is different from a transcript delta. Only emitted when `audio.input.transcription.model` is set to `grok-transcribe` in the session configuration. Useful for displaying live captions.

serverMessages.description: A DTMF tone (phone keypress) was detected on a SIP session. SIP only — not emitted on direct WebSocket connections. Digits are buffered server-side and flushed as a text message to the model on `#` key, 2.5s idle, or when the user begins speaking.
